newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama to be key bunker fuel distribution site.
newsitem.headline: Panama to be key bunker fuel distribution site.

text.p: Panama is on target with plans to turn a naval base into a world center for bunker fuel distribution, a top government official said.

"This is one of the biggest enterprises Panama wants to do and we're closer," National Port Authority Deputy General Director Ruben Reyna Reyna said. "In two years we'll have all ancillary services in place and it will be world class."

Two of Rodman Naval Station's three piers and an 806-acre (326-hectare) tank farm will be turned over to Panamanian control Wednesday. The entire station, which is in U.S. hands, is due to be turned over by 1999.
The area's one-million-barrel capacity is expected to double by next year, Reyna said, adding that Panama's other ports do not have enough capacity for bunker fuel distribution.
